title: Christmas in Sapporo 2026: 3 places for markets and lights
description: Plan Christmas in Sapporo 2026 with Odori’s German market, Ekimae-dori lights and the Sapporo Factory tree, including dates, hours and a practical route.
intro: Christmas in Sapporo in 2026 can be organised around three different places: Odori Park for the German market and light installations, Ekimae-dori for an illuminated city walk, and Sapporo Factory for the tree in its atrium. Check each calendar separately. The market and Odori illumination venue finish on December 25; the Ekimae-dori lights continue until February 11, 2027.

This seasonal guide to Sapporo, Hokkaido, complements our selection of permanent city sights. It helps with dates, the order of the walk and suitable breaks, using information published by the organisers and tourism association. The documentary photographs show the places in the identified years and seasons; older decorations are not presented as this December’s installations.

quickFacts.label: Route structure
quickFacts.value: Outdoor walking, indoor breaks and transport adapted to your mobility

sections.heading: 1. Odori Park: the German market and illumination in one stop
paragraphs: Start with Odori if you want a market atmosphere and part of Sapporo White Illumination within the same area. The organiser’s detailed 2026 programme places the German market in both Odori Park 1-chome and 2-chome: the first block combines decorations and activities, while the second emphasises food and Christmas goods. It runs from November 20 to December 25, from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., with last orders at 8:45 p.m. The market began in 2002, when Sapporo celebrated thirty years of sister-city ties with Munich. Eating and shopping remain separate choices within the visit.

Then choose which Odori installations you want to explore. This venue has its own calendar, also ending on December 25, and the organiser publishes usual lighting hours of 4:30–10 p.m., extended until midnight on December 23–25. It notes that hours may change. Read this edition’s notice before setting out: the third block introduces a new installation inspired by a fountain of light. The March 2026 night photograph documents the park before this season rather than that installation.

sections.heading: 2. Ekimae-dori: follow the lights from the station towards Susukino
paragraphs: Ekimae-dori offers a more linear experience. The avenue connects the area around JR Sapporo Station with Susukino, and the organiser describes approximately 1.5 kilometres of illuminated trees. Choose a section to combine with Odori instead of walking the entire length out of obligation. Look from the pavements and use designated crossings; this remains a working city street throughout the celebration.

The venue runs from November 20, 2026 to February 11, 2027. Published lighting hours are 4:30–10 p.m., with a midnight extension on December 23–25. If you travel after Christmas, the later end date gives you an illuminated walking option even though the Odori market has finished. The 2009 photograph records the street during the day. Choose the end that best suits your accommodation and identify where to pause or use transport before starting the walk.

sections.heading: 3. Sapporo Factory: the atrium tree and a covered break
paragraphs: The third place changes the setting: Sapporo Factory installs its Christmas tree inside the atrium. The tourism association confirms the November 3–December 25, 2026 season, and the operator announces lighting from 4–10 p.m. The tree uses a fir approximately fifteen metres tall. According to the programme, a music-and-light sequence lasting about five minutes takes place on the hour. Check the current notice if timing your arrival around that sequence is important to you.

The atrium belongs to the complex at Kita 2-jo Higashi 4-chome. Treat it as a separate stop off the direct Ekimae-dori axis and choose the connection around the weather and your energy. The 2006 archive photograph helps identify its large glass roof without showing the 2026 tree. Dining, shopping and other services within the complex follow individual businesses’ arrangements. Leave time to find the atrium rather than assuming a shop’s opening hours are also the tree’s illumination schedule.

sections.heading: Choose your dates around the experience you want
paragraphs: To combine all three experiences in this guide, the calendars overlap from November 20 to December 25, 2026. If the German market or Factory tree is your main reason for travelling, that closing date matters when booking accommodation. A longer illumination season on another avenue does not automatically extend the dates of a market or indoor venue.

December 23, 24 and 25 have an announced lighting extension at Odori and Ekimae-dori. Decide whether it suits your plans: a longer time outdoors calls for breaks and a return journey that works with your transport. Factory retains its published 4–10 p.m. schedule. Check programme updates and the connection back before extending the evening. Installation hours are not a train or subway timetable. The lighting extension does not extend market trading, which ends at 9 p.m.

sections.heading: Transport, entrances and a route you can shorten
paragraphs: The organisers recommend public transport to the venues. Odori Station is served by the Tozai, Namboku and Toho lines; the event map identifies a lift at Exit 8 beside the park’s third block. If you need that entrance, check the complete route to your chosen stop, including the street crossing. Saving a particular exit reference is more useful than arriving underground and choosing a staircase at random.

Build the outing from independent blocks: the Odori market and installations, a section of Ekimae-dori, and the Factory atrium. You can spread them across two afternoons. This flexibility lets you adapt outdoor time to the cold, ground conditions and tiredness. Take warm layers, gloves and footwear suited to winter surfaces. An archive photograph cannot forecast the snow you will find on a particular travel date.

sections.heading: Budgeting and the rest of your Sapporo stay
paragraphs: Decide what you want to spend on food and shopping before entering the market. A commemorative cup, a meal and a souvenir belong to your personal walking budget; this guide does not publish stall prices that may change. At Factory, separate the reason for visiting the atrium from the time you will spend eating or shopping. That gives all three stops room to develop naturally instead of turning the evening into a race between purchases and connections.

For the rest of the stay, our general Sapporo guide develops other city places and outings that need separate planning. If comparing the festive season across Japan, the Christmas in Tokyo and Fukuoka guides cover their own programmes. Check dates and transfers between those stages before booking. This route concentrates on Sapporo while leaving you room to decide which other experiences belong in your trip.

itinerary: First part of the afternoon: visit Sapporo Factory if its tree and light sequence are priorities. Locate the atrium and leave room for the onward journey to the centre, choosing a connection that fits the actual conditions.

After the lights begin: give a block of time to Odori Park, combining the market in the first and second blocks with whichever installations interest you. The market closes at 9 p.m., before the lights; keep those schedules separate when ordering the visit.

End of the walk: follow a section of Ekimae-dori in the direction that makes your return easier. With two afternoons, keep one for Factory and one for Odori and the avenue. After December 25, centre the route on venues whose announced seasons are still running.

faq.question: When is Sapporo’s Christmas market in 2026?
faq.answer: The organiser’s detailed programme announces the German Christmas Market from November 20 to December 25, 2026 at Odori Park 1-chome and 2-chome. It opens from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., with last orders at 8:45 p.m. Check the programme for particular activities or stalls.

faq.question: Do Sapporo’s lights continue after Christmas?
faq.answer: It depends on the place. Ekimae-dori’s calendar continues until February 11, 2027. The Odori market and illumination venue covered here finish on December 25, which is also the final date of the Factory tree season.

faq.question: What time is the Sapporo Factory tree illuminated?
faq.answer: The 2026 announcement gives 4–10 p.m., from November 3 to December 25. It includes an approximately five-minute music-and-light sequence on the hour. Check the current notice before fixing your arrival time around a performance.

faq.question: Can you combine all three places in one afternoon?
faq.answer: You can organise a selection while allowing time for Factory and the central walk. How long you spend at the market, the weather and your mobility determine how much walking is sensible. Dividing the stops between two afternoons is also useful.

conclusion: First choose the experience that justifies your travel dates: Odori’s market, a walk along the illuminated avenue or the Factory tree. With separate calendars and a route that is easy to shorten, you can spend time in each setting without rushing connections. Sapporo offers a varied Christmas outing when outdoor walking and breaks respond to the actual conditions of the day.
